csv_project_name: Engineering Svc for Capital Improvement Projects
csv_scope_of_work: The Community College District ("Owner") seeks to retain a qualified engineering firm ("Consultant") to provide professional engineering services for the planning, design, permitting, bidding, construction administration, and closeout of capital improvement projects across the District's campuses and facilities. Projects may include new construction, renovations, infrastructure improvements, utility upgrades, site development, and modernization of academic, administrative, student services, workforce training, and support facilities. All services shall comply with applicable requirements of the State of Texas, local jurisdictions, and accreditation standards applicable to higher education facilities.
csv_disciplines_requested: Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
